answer: Per-identity task watermarking assigns each registered agent a unique hidden marker inside ordinary work requests—a whisper in the input distribution that only that identity should follow. Enforcement compares marker-handling histories; duplicated agents expose themselves when their outputs trace a correlated spiral of matching errors across accounts. An attacker can fabricate a fable of independence, but must build and maintain a separate marker-correct pipeline per identity, paying storage, compute, and monitoring cost for every account.
